# `test` standard library

The `test` module provides a lightweight assertion and test-reporting harness with
pass/fail counters, descriptive failure diagnostics, and exit-code summaries.

```{.dva .run}
#use test

test::eq(2 + 2, 4, "basic addition")
test::ne("edva", "rust", "distinct strings")
test::approx(3.14159, 3.1416, 0.001)
test::summary!
```

## Function catalog

| Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `test::check(cond[, msg])` | `<>, [String] => <>` | Asserts that boolean condition `cond` is `<+>` |
| `test::ok(res[, msg])` | `R, [String] => <>` | Asserts that ramification `res` is in its positive state (`<+>`, `<+ v +>`, `<+ v ->`) |
| `test::err(res[, msg])` | `R, [String] => <>` | Asserts that ramification `res` is in its negative state (`<->`, `<-->`, `<- e +>`) |
| `test::eq(actual, expected[, msg])` | `#param T: Type, T, T[, String] => <>` | Asserts structural equality `actual == expected` across scalars, records, tuples, enums, options, arrays, slices, and maps |
| `test::ne(actual, expected[, msg])` / `test::neq` | `#param T: Type, T, T[, String] => <>` | Asserts structural inequality `actual != expected` |
| `test::struct_eq(a, b)` | `#param T: Type, T, T => <>` | Compile-time specialized deep structural equality check |
| `test::format_val(v)` | `#param T: Type, T => String` | Compile-time specialized structural value formatter used in failure diagnostics |
| `test::approx(actual, expected, eps, msg)` | `Float, Float, Float, String => <>` | Asserts `|actual - expected| <= eps` |
| `test::fail(msg)` | `String => <>` | Unconditionally records a test failure with `msg` |
| `test::suite(name, body)` | `String, (() => ()) => ()` | Runs `body` under named suite header `=== Suite: <name> ===` |
| `test::reset!` | `() => ()` | Resets passed and failed counters to `0` |
| `test::passed!` / `test::failed!` / `test::total!` | `() => Int` | Queries current assertion counters |
| `test::summary!` | `() => ()` | Prints `PASS: N passed, 0 failed` (or `FAIL: ...` and exits `1`) |
| `test::finish!` | `() => Int` | Prints summary and returns `0` if all passed or `1` if any failed |
| `test::fuzz(name, seeds, prop)` | `String, String{}, (String => <>) => <>` | Coverage-guided mutation fuzzer replaying seeds/disk corpus and shrinking failures |
| `test::fuzz_opts(name, seeds, runs, seed, prop)` | `String, String{}, Int, Int, (String => <>) => <>` | Configurable coverage-guided fuzz target (supports `EDVA_FUZZ`, `EDVA_FUZZ_RUNS`, `EDVA_FUZZ_TIME`, `EDVA_FUZZ_SEED`, `EDVA_FUZZ_CORPUS`) |
| `test::forall(name, gen, prop)` | `#param T: Type, String, (rand::Rng => T), (T => <>) => <>` | Runs 100 seeded property checks in a per-iteration scratch arena (shrinks `String` failures) |
| `test::forall_opts(name, runs, seed, gen, prop)` | `#param T: Type, String, Int, Int, (rand::Rng => T), (T => <>) => <>` | Configurable seeded property-based testing harness |
| `test::shrink_str(s, prop)` | `String, (String => <>) => String` | Hierarchically reduces a failing `String` via chunk, line, byte, and alphabet passes |
| `test::gen_int(lo, hi)` / `test::gen_ascii(n)` / `test::gen_utf8(n)` | `Int[, Int] => (rand::Rng => ...)` | Built-in property generators for uniform ints, ASCII strings, and UTF-8 strings |
| `test::cov_clear!` / `test::cov_edges!` / `test::cov_trace(id)` | `() => ()` / `() => Int` / `Int => ()` | Inspect, clear, or record entries in the built-in 64 KB `@__dva_cov_map` edge bitmap |

## Fuzzing and property testing

```{.dva .run}
#use json
#use test

seeds = String{}("{\"ok\":true}", "[1, 2, 3]")
test::fuzz("json_parse", seeds, (s => _r = json::parse(s); <+>))
test::forall("int_range", test::gen_int(-10, 10), (n => n !< -10 && n !> 10))
test::finish!
```

Compile with `--fuzz-cov` (or run `edva test --fuzz`) to instrument functions, cycles, and choice branches with the built-in 64 KB edge bitmap (`@__dva_cov_map`), plus `__sanitizer_cov_trace_pc_guard` hooks when external sanitizer coverage is enabled. Each iteration runs inside a scratch `mem::Arena` reset between inputs.
